name: FED Fitness SH1 0°/7° Adjustable All-in-One Home Gym Smith Machine
shortDesc:
Brand: Flybird
Authentic Amazon Best-Seller Edition
Category: HOME GYM
Warranty: 1-Year Comprehensive Manufacturer Warranty
description:
Amazon Best-Seller: FED Fitness SH1 0°/7° Adjustable All-in-One Home Gym Smith Machine

SH1 is an all-in-one Smith machine with a functional trainer built into the same frame. It also has a squat rack with J-hooks and spotter arms, a multi-grip pull-up bar, a lat pulldown bar, dip handles and a landmine, so one station covers presses, squats, pulls and cable work.

0° vertical or 7° angled Smith bar path

Switch the bar path by hand, without tools. The 7° angled setting suits squats, hack squats and hip thrusts, where the bar travels back with your hips. The 0° setting suits bench press, seated shoulder press and calf raises. The bar runs on linear ball bearings over steel rods.

1:1 cable system

Two independent cable columns run on 20 CNC-machined aluminum pulleys at a 1:1 ratio, so the load you select is the load at the handle. If you are used to a 2:1 machine, the same number will feel heavier. Set each pulley high for pulldowns, at chest height for flyes or low for rows, and brace on the built-in seated row footplate.

SH1 or SH1 Pro

SH1 is plate-loaded and takes 2 in Olympic plates. Choose SH1 Pro if you want a Smith machine with a weight stack system: two 88 lb stacks (176 lb total) that you change with a selector pin, plus loading horns for Olympic plates when the next pin setting is too big a jump.

Sized for a garage gym

At 78.7 x 79.1 x 85.6 in (W x D x H), SH1 is a home gym Smith machine with cables that fits under a standard 8 ft ceiling. Four plate pegs, a metal pegboard and a vertical barbell holder keep plates, handles and the bar off the floor.

Whether you're racking heavy squats, switching to cable flyes, or dialing in Smith bench, you stay on one platform — no tear-down, no plate handling between sets, no walking to a separate stack. Where many all-in-one trainers present cable crossover or Smith as paid upgrade modules, the M3 Pro integrates all three natively.

Feature 4: Cable System That Doesn't Twist or Stick

The M3 Pro uses a 2:1 pulley ratio with 16 aluminum pulleys, engineered against twist, stick, and rub — common pain points across cable systems in this category. Cable trolleys allow single-hand height adjustment across 29 positions for flys, rows, curls, and accessory work. Knurled metal grip points and aluminum end caps deliver refined, predictable resistance every rep, with consistent feel between sets without manual unwinding.

Feature 5: True 2.2m Olympic Smith Bar

The M3 Pro uses a true 2.2 m / 30 mm Olympic Smith bar — full Olympic length, not a shortened replica — with a knurled grip and a 10-position quick rack plate system. Stainless hanging plates rack and unrack with a smooth, natural motion. Combined with the 560 mm extended safety arms (650 lb static), the system provides two layers of fail-safe between the lifter and the floor — built for solo benching past usual rep ranges and for users training around past injuries.

Four 300 mm stainless storage rods fit 2-inch Olympic plates, a rear pegboard with 10 hook positions, a center crossbar holds accessories or supports dip-style training, and a Quick Mount Landmine installs on any open hole position. description:
Amazon Best-Seller: RitFit M3 PRO Smith Machine

Features

Feature 1: Uniform 3"×3" Frame, 11-Gauge Front-to-Back

Built with uniform 75 × 75 × 3 mm A36 steel uprights — front, middle, and rear posts share the same 3"×3" / 11-gauge / 3mm spec, where many multi-functional racks step down to 2"×3" or 2"×2" tubing on the middle and rear posts. Combined with a reinforced twin-base support and the rack's 1,093 lb of total steel mass, the frame stays planted front-to-back during heavy presses, deadlifts, and squats. Safety arms extend 560 mm with 650 lb static rating for solo training peace of mind.

Feature 2: A Full Strength Platform in 21.5 sqft

The M3 Pro fits power rack, cable crossover, and Smith machine into a 21.5 sqft footprint — about the floor space of a parked SUV. Whether you're carving out a corner of a one-car garage or fitting a full home gym into a basement, you keep three strength stations on the floor space most all-in-one trainers consume with one. Highest upright hole sits at 1,980 mm (78 inch), so the rack clears most low-ceiling basements and apartments.

Feature 3: Three Strength Stations + 180 LB Built-in Stacks per Side

Power rack, cable crossover, and Smith machine — three stations on one platform, with 180 LB of built-in weight stacks per side (18 plates × 4.5 kg) at a 2:1 cable ratio. Whether you're racking heavy squats, switching to cable flyes, or dialing in Smith bench, you stay on one platform — no tear-down, no plate handling between sets, no walking to a separate stack. Where many all-in-one trainers present cable crossover or Smith as paid upgrade modules, the M3 Pro integrates all three natively.

Feature 4: Cable System That Doesn't Twist or Stick

The M3 Pro uses a 2:1 pulley ratio with 16 aluminum pulleys, engineered against twist, stick, and rub — common pain points across cable systems in this category. Cable trolleys allow single-hand height adjustment across 29 positions for flys, rows, curls, and accessory work. Knurled metal grip points and aluminum end caps deliver refined, predictable resistance every rep, with consistent feel between sets without manual unwinding.

Feature 5: True 2.2m Olympic Smith Bar

The M3 Pro uses a true 2.2 m / 30 mm Olympic Smith bar — full Olympic length, not a shortened replica — with a knurled grip and a 10-position quick rack plate system. Stainless hanging plates rack and unrack with a smooth, natural motion. Combined with the 560 mm extended safety arms (650 lb static), the system provides two layers of fail-safe between the lifter and the floor — built for solo benching past usual rep ranges and for users training around past injuries.

Feature 6: Storage Built Into the Frame

Four 300 mm stainless storage rods fit 2-inch Olympic plates, a rear pegboard with 10 hook positions, a center crossbar holds accessories or supports dip-style training, and a Quick Mount Landmine installs on any open hole position. The storage hardware listed above ships together with the rack frame in one wooden crate.

More Details

  • Laser Cut Upright Numbering — Laser-cut numbering on the uprights helps line up attachments faster with less guesswork during setup or position changes.
  • Balanced Weight Stack Design — A smaller top plate and four balance screws help the stack move evenly, delivering smoother resistance through every rep.
  • Knurled Carbon-Steel Pull-Up Bar — A solid carbon-steel pull-up bar with knurled grip zones at a 2,108 mm (83 inch) height, sized for stable overhand and underhand pull-up training even for taller lifters.
  • Longer 560 mm Safety Arms — Extended safety arms provide additional catch space and confidence when training alone with heavier lifts.
  • Sandwich-Style J-Hooks — J-Hooks combine carbon steel outer layers with a protective inner core for refined feel and better bar contact during racking.
  • Quick-Mount Landmine — The quick-mount landmine installs on any open hole position, adding flexibility for setup, storage, and rotational training without needing a separate base.

description:
Amazon Best-Seller: Needle Low Profile Spotter Arms

Spotter arms should disappear into your training. You set them, lift, and move on. The problem is most of them are too bulky to ignore.

Standard spotter arms are large, heavy, and occupy a significant stretch of your upright. On a rack like the Dane 2, that eats into the holes you need for other attachments and makes repositioning between exercises more work than it should be. If you're running a fully kitted setup, oversized spotter arms are a real problem.

The Needle was designed around a different set of priorities. Each arm is 15 lbs and takes up roughly 3.5 holes on your upright, compared to the 7 holes a standard spotter arm uses on the Dane 2. The profile is slim at 2.5" wide with a weight capacity of 700 lbs. 

The mounting system uses two points of contact: the magpin runs side to side through the upright and the bracket rests on two edges, distributing the load and keeping the arm stable under heavy weight. The lowest mounting position on the Dane 2 and similar units puts the arm at 14 inches off the floor, which covers the range you need for low bench work and floor-level pressing movements.

Compatibility was built in from the start. UHMW shims inside the bracket let the Needle fit racks with 1" or 5/8" holes in both metric and imperial configurations. Most spotter arms are locked to one rack ecosystem. The Needle works across them all. If you have a 5/8" rack, this is the answer you've been looking for.

The arms also have 1" holes along the sides and top, so you can attach compatible accessories and build out your setup beyond basic spotting. A dedicated 5/8" hole on each arm stores the magpin when you're not using it. Both magpins are included.

WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN MILSPEC AND STANDARD BLACK PLATES?

At first glance, you'll notice the first difference is purely cosmetic; the Milspec Plates have a matte black finish, vs a glossy black finish on standard black bumper plates. Milspec plates are also slightly thinner than our standard black plates, with a more rounded edge. In the end, both plates are great, and you should be confident in knowing you are using the best bumper plates on the market today.

BUMPER PLATE OVERVIEW

Bumper Plates are a necessity for any garage gym, and there are plenty of reasons why.

WHAT IS A BUMPER PLATE?

A bumper plate is a weight plate for Olympic bars that is made almost entirely of rubber (with a steel or brass collar in the middle that accepts an Olympic bar).

WHY BUMPER PLATES?

The "end state" of the Olympic lifts is overhead or at the shoulder. Many lifters drop the weights from overhead. Since bumper plates are almost entirely rubber, being dumped from the shoulder or overhead will not damage the weights, bar, floor, bystanders, the lifter, etc...

Bumper plates are also great for garage gym use- the rubber construction is much quieter than traditional metal construction.

WHAT EXERCISES CAN I DO WITH BUMPER PLATES?

Snatch
Clean and Jerk
Press
Thruster
Deadlift
Squat
Bench
Overhead lunge
And even more!




EXCELLENT: QUALITY, PRICE, TIME


"I've now purchased 55, 45, 35, 25, & 10lb pairs from Fringe. I'm super pleased with every purchase. Delivery is always quicker than I expect & packaged well. The plates feel great in your hand, match well, and are plenty durable. 10lb plates are always super thin, but these feel solid. Love working with Fringe!"

- Kevin B.

WHY CHOOSE FRINGE SPORT BUMPER PLATES?

Not all bumpers are created equal. Here's why your next bumper plates should be Fringe Sport bumpers:

  1. Fringe Sport bumper plates feature a steel insert that is designed to far outperform the brass bumpers used by the competition. A steel insert will take much more abuse without malforming- and it is machined to exact tolerances to fit all high-quality Olympic bars.
  2. Fringe Sport bumpers use a rubber formulation that combines the ideal mix of low bounce with high durability. Some bumper plates bounce too much- they are potentially unsafe. Other bumpers are too brittle- and they easily chip and fall apart. Not Fringe Sport bumper plates!
  3. Fringe Sport bumpers 10 and 15 lb bumpers are more stable because they have high durability. This makes them more stable than most 10 or 15 lb bumpers which are the most fragile bumper plates due to their thinness.
  4. Fringe Sport bumpers are thinner than many of the competing bumpers- so you can load more weight on your bar!
  5. Fringe Sport bumpers all have the same standard diameter- you can mix and match to load your bar.
  6. Finally, Fringe Sport bumper plates are backed by our no-questions-asked satisfaction guarantee- plus a 1-year warranty (on the 25-35-45-55's). Use them and love them- or send them back free!



MILSPEC BUMPER PLATE SPECS

  • Quantity: 2 - Black Bumper Plates (1 Pair)
  • Weight: 10-55 pounds each
  • Weight Tolerance: +/- 1% of declared weight
  • Full Diameter: 15 - 55 pound plates: 450mm (~17.7 inches) width, 10 pound plate: 450mm (10 pound plate has +- 1% width tolerance)
  • Insert Diameter: 2 inches
  • Bumper Plate Widths: 55's - 3.2", 45's - 2.9", 35's - 2.35", 25's - 1.87", 15's - 1.2", 10's - 1.05"
  • Durometer: 10's and 15's are 90 sHA; the 25, 35, 45 and 55 pound bumpers are 85 sHA.
  • Material: Virgin rubber, stainless steel insert
  • Warranty: 1 Year Warranty on 25's, 35's, 45's and 55's; 90 days on the 10's and 15's

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How wide are these bumpers?

55's are 3.2", 45's are 2.9'', 35's are 2.35'', 25's are 1.87'' 15's are 1.2'', and the 10's are 1.05''

What is the durometer reading on these bumpers?

The 10 and 15-pound bumper plates are 90; the 25, 35, 45 and 55-pound bumpers are 85

What does durometer mean?

Durometer is a measure of the hardness of a material. It ranges from 0-100, and the higher the rating the harder the material, and the higher the material's resistance to indentation. Anything above 65 is acceptable for bumper plates. Our plates are considered to be excellent.

Why do different weight bumper plates have different durometer readings?

In general, the lighter bumper plates have a higher durometer reading because they need to be more rigid to withstand the stress of being dropped. Heavier plates have more surface area to distribute the stress, so they do not need to be as hard.

What is the diameter of these bumpers?

Most Fringe Sport bumper plates are the IWF standard 450mm (~17.7") width in diameter, with a   +/-1.5mm variance

The ten-pound Fringe Sport bumpers are 445mm (17.5") in diameter

What? Why are the ten-pound bumpers narrower than all the rest?

The ten-pound bumper plates are purposefully 5mm narrower than the other bumper plates so that when you have 10's loaded on the bar, plus other bumpers, the 10-pound plates impact the ground a split second later than the other bumpers. Since the 10-pound plates have the least surface area and are thus the weakest bumpers, this saves stress on your 10 pounders!

My bumpers smell. Do you carry bumpers that don't smell?

Sometimes the bumpers smell due to the way that they are made. It isn't permanent. The best remedy is to let them air out in the sun for about 5 days.

My bumpers are greasy? How can I get the grease off?

The bumpers are greased as a part of the manufacturing process. Sometimes the factory doesn't clean the plates well enough. Here's what we do to de-grease these bad boys:

We wash the bumpers about 3 times, with paper towels, soap, and water. If that doesn't work, then we use a de-greaser spray that can be purchased at a local home improvement store.

Can I drop the 10-pound bumpers like I see my favorite athletes do?

Drop away. We are confident that our 10-pound bumper plates can handle the abuse, and they are backed by our fully comprehensive warranty for 1 year just in case.

What does it mean if there is a white star on my bumper?

Some of our plates go through random spot checks by different quality assurance teams. The star simply means your plate passed inspection. There are no differences in quality between plates with or without stars!

How can I choose the plates that are right for me?

Bumper plates come in a few standard sizes and are sold in pounds with kilogram conversions. Fringe Sport economy bumpers are sold by the pound. Here is a chart with a rough pound and kilogram weights:


Bumper Weight Best Weight For:
10 lbs ~ 5 kg Great for teaching or learning Olympic lifts.
15 lbs ~ 7 kg The same uses as the 10s, but this offers greater durability at only a slightly heavier weight.
25 lbs ~ 11 kg A very popular weight as they are very durable and throwing these on an Oly bar gives you 95 pounds (Fran Rx).
35 lbs ~ 16 kg A great size for adding more weight to the bar.
45 lbs ~ 20 kg The most popular size for gyms - 45's really lets you load up your bar and make some serious strength gains.
55 lbs ~ 25 kg When the 45s just don't cut it, we have 55lb bumpers to add some serious weight to the bar.

      WHAT TO KNOW ABOUT MILSPEC BUMPER PLATES

      These Milspec bumper plates are designed to the exacting tolerances and high durability requirements of the US Army. These bumper plates are used every day by soldiers training for and completing the ACFT- the Army Combat Fitness Test.

      Are you training to be an elite soldier- or just training for the fitness level of an elite soldier? These milspec bumper plates are there for you!

      Fringe Sport black bumper plates are manufactured to go toe to toe with any bumper plate on the market. They are constructed with virgin rubber, formulated specifically for its durability, density and low bounce. Most importantly, they go through the most customer-focused manufacturing, quality control, and shipping process in the industry so you can rest assured that you are getting the highest quality plates and we are taking the utmost care to ensure they arrive to you in pristine condition!

Like any piece of equipment, your resistance bands need to be properly taken care of to extend the life for continued use. What is a Stubby Axle bar?

LET'S GET FAT (FAT BARBELLS THAT IS)

Strongman (and strong woman) competitors have been using "Axle" bars for years. Axle bars have thick grips- 2" vs the 1 1/8" shaft of a normal barbell. These axle bars make lifting harder as most people cannot close their hand fully around the bar. Working an axle bar into your routine will result in stronger grip, thicker forearms, and a stronger back.

Axle bars are most well-known for deadlift movements and for shoulder-to-overhead presses, but are also great to work in to your routine for bench press, farmer's holds, zercher squats, bicep curls, and more.

However, axle bars are not the greatest choice for a primary barbell since their collars do not rotate, making them a poor choice for Olympic weightlifting or similar lifts.

 

WHAT MAKES EL GORDITO SPECIAL?

Bought in to Axle Bar training? Great! Here's why El Gordito is the perfect fat bar for you.

  • Short Length gets you all the axle bar benefits... in less space
  • The powder coat and rings make El Gordito a joy in the hand (and a strain on the forearms)
  • 1000 pound weight capacity means that you never hae to worry about outgrowing the bar
  • Rackability means easy loading and easy versatility
  • Use your standard collars- no special equipment needed!

It's OK to Get Short with Us and "El Gordito"

Fringe fanatics love our axle bar with gusto, so they asked us to give them the short end of the stick. Now our favorite couple in the Fringe Family have delivered a new addition to the "Gordo Family." We're happy to introduce to you our height restricted axle bar, El Gordito.

The little boy of El Gordazo and La Gordita, he completes the Gordo family. Like his dad, he probably sneaks an extra taco or two when no one is looking. But who are we to complain? He's just as beefy and rugged as the rest of the family.

If you're into strongman or if you just want to blast your forearms and improve grip strength, you're going to be crushing hard on this bar in no time.

  • Improve grip strength with 2in diameter shaft, great for strongman workouts.
  • Collars are 2in diameter so 2in Olympic Barbell collars fit perfectly.
  • Powder-coated matte black finish.

Life is Short, Live it to the Strongest

We took our popular regulation axle bar and cut it down to size. The short version we created, looks like a section of black iron, outdoor drainage pipe the Hulk ripped off the wall for you. Your strongman goals won't be pipe dreams with the shorty though. Don't hesitate to employ the shorty for functional fitness, overhead presses, Zydrunas presses or the dreaded continental clean. After a short stint of axle training in your garage, you'll be slaying job interviews, business meetings, dates and negotiations in no time.

There are a few things to note for the Short Axle Barbell.

  • This is a true strongman axle / fat bar - there is no knurling on the bar.
  • The 2" diameter includes the shaft of the bar, explaining the "fat bar" nickname.
  • This is one, solid bar. The collars do not rotate.

After you get through the adversity, you'll come to love us. Here's why.

You're not here for status. You're not here to show off. You're not here to be cool. You're not here to look good.

You're here to work. You're here to sweat. You're here to get strong. You're here for the discipline.

You're here because of the fierce durability that's the hallmark of Fringe Sport bumpers, you've come to know and expect. You're here for the level of Fringe Sport toughness that matches you and your workouts.

  • IWF diameter standard. 450 mm with a tolerance of +/- 1 mm
  • Weighed and guaranteed accurate to +/- 1% of declared weight.
  • Durometer rating of 90 Shore A. Our plates feel just right with a dead bounce.
  • 7.75" steel insert width. Makes drops a non-issue with max toughness.
  • 50.4mm collar opening. Fits most Olympic barbells, like our men's Oly weightlifting bar.
  • Color-coded plates to easily differentiate weights.
  • Raised rubber rims ensure minimal friction between plates, increasing durability.
  • Raised contrast lettering with a matte finish.
  • Pound and kilogram sets, whichever your bar prefers.
  • 1 Year Warranty - Full year satisfaction guarantee.
  • 5 Year "Bumper to Bumper" Warranty against manufacturer defects.

Product Contents and Specifications

  • Quantity: 2 Black Training Competition Bumper Plates (1 Pair)
  • Weight: 25 lb, 35 lb, 45 lb or 55 lb (11kg, 16kg, 20kg, 25kg)

Reinforcements

Fringe It, or Forget It

Don't worry about hitting a bump in the road either. Not only do we stand behind our product, but we lift under them too. Whether that means using Fringe Sport bumpers daily at Fringe Sport headquarters (you're invited to come in and workout with us anytime) or offering impeccable customer service. We strive to be your trusted workout partner and trainer. Our 1-year warranty features a full satisfaction guarantee, not to mention our 5-year "Bumper to Bumper" warranty against manufacturer defects.

If you aren't happy with your purchase for whatever reason within the first 30 days, we'll give you a full refund and foot the bill for return shipping. We aim to please, so our return policies †even extend up to a year. We have our commercial customers' backs too. If you own a box or a gym, we've got our equipment spotted for you.

We have an informal state motto here in Texas- "come and take it." Not only do we want you to do this with Fringe Sport bumper plates, but we'd like to put our own spin on it. Fringe it, or forget it.

The Dane 2.0 features a half rack in the front with a commercial grade functional trainer built into the rack. The combination of squat rack & functional trainer in one provides a smaller footprint (and lower price point) than two stand alone units. With a length of only 60” from front to back, The Dane 2.0 is extremely space efficient for all the functionality it brings to the table. The squat rack is sturdy, commercial grade, and includes a pair of low-profile spotter arms for performing squats outside the rack. The pulley system is also highly adjustable, allowing you to customize the angle, range of motion, and resistance for each exercise.

  • Combines a half rack and functional trainer into a compact 60” footprint, saving space and cost compared to separate units
  • Dual 160lb weight stacks with a 1:1 pulley ratio, so 100lbs feels like 100lbs
  • The highly adjustable cable system features 180-degree swivel pulleys and smooth-gliding trolleys for cable work outside of the rack
  • 11-gauge steel construction with 3" x 3" uprights and 1” holes
  • The improved top plate design, which has been reduced from 10lbs to 5lbs, allows for a lighter starting weight & more precise adjustments
  • The new compact weight stack design allows for up to 5.8’ of cable travel outside of the rack
  • Includes upgraded reverse sandwich J-Cups, low profile spotter arms, a pair of D-Handles, extensions feet, and a landmine attachment at no additional cost ($600 value)
  • Lifetime warranty on the rack and a 5 year warranty on the pulley system

One of the biggest upgrades on the Dane 2.0 is the improved top plate design, which has been reduced from 10lbs to 5lbs based on user feedback. Many lifters requested a lighter starting weight for more precise adjustments, especially for isolation exercises, rehab work, and beginner-friendly training. We've also added a dedicated hole for the selector pin when using only the top plate, making it easier and more secure to lock in your starting weight.

We’ve also re-engineered the weight stack design to be more compact, which increases cable travel outside of the rack. The Dane 1.0 allowed for 5 feet of cable movement, but the Dane 2.0 extends nearly 6 feet, giving you more freedom for full-range movements. Despite this increased range of motion, the Dane 2.0 maintains its dual 160lb weight stacks with a 1:1 pulley ratio, delivering true-to-weight resistance in a compact footprint.

The Dane 2.0 is also equipped with upgraded aluminum pulleys featuring a wider pulley channel, which minimizes friction and drag. This ensures a more direct force transfer and an overall smoother pull.

Unlike other systems that require you to spend hundreds more on essential accessories, the Dane 2.0 includes five attachments at no additional charge, a value of over $600. With these five additional attachments, the Dane 2.0 delivers a versatile training setup right out of the box, making it one of the most comprehensive and cost-effective functional trainers on the market today.

  1. Two D-handles
  2. A pair of Reverse Sandwich J-cups

Your Smith Machine has been holding out on you.

One bar. One path. Both arms locked to the same line, which is great until your stronger side quietly takes over. The imbalance builds. The bar covers for it. You don't find out your weak side ends up looking like a certain cartoon coyote after a bad day: flattened, smoking, holding a sign that says "ouch."

The Anvil Handles fix that.

Two independent handles: one for each hand, each doing its own honest work. Mount them to the BYOB Smith attachment and each one rides the rail independently on commercial-grade linear bearings. Every rep is honestly left and honestly right. An anvil you’ll actually want to see coming at you.

Press, row, go unilateral and load up to 220 LBS / 100 KG PER HANDLE (440 LBS / 200 KG across the pair). Iso-lateral. Not itty-bitty.

On the Smith, the travel is buttery smooth rep after rep, and each handle's built-in hook means you rack and unrack from the top, just like a real bar, instead of starting every set from the bottom like you're emerging from a squat you didn't plan.

FOUR WAYS TO GET ANVIL'D.

  • Already own the BYOB Smith attachment? Add the Anvil Handles, swap the bar, upgrade your life.
  • Starting from scratch? Grab the Smith + Handles set. Rails, guided motion, and the iso-lateral toolkit in one shot.
  • Have a Smith with the built-in bar? There's a conversion kit for that. Your bar had a good run. It’s time for an upgrade.
  • Just here for the handles? You're already in the right place. Use them on the rails, off the rails for some weird forearm workout, or whatever you have in mind (we listen and we don’t judge).

The Hydra and Manticore rack families are the natural home for this setup, but the Smith attachment fits most 2.3"–3" uprights, so check your rack before you order.
Not sure where to start? The full Smith Machine collection has the options laid out.

Whatever your path, add to cart and go lift some weight.

Every square foot of your training space is spoken for. The last thing you need is a dedicated anchor point eating into it or a door you can no longer use.

The Ceiling Mount bolts inside a standard 3" / 76 mm door frame at just 2.75" / 70 mm wide, and the door still closes behind it. Permanent anchor, zero interruptions.That's just the default. Bolt it into any solid wood (ceiling joist, wall stud, overhead beam) and you've got a reliable anchor point that unlocks pull-ups, dips, vertical push-ups, and straight-down rows you simply can't do from a door setup.

ONE MOUNT. DOZENS OF EXERCISES. The Ceiling Mount is a fixed anchor for your Human Trainer, gymnastics rings, Ripcords, or any clip-based resistance band setup. Clip on, train, clip off. The anchor stays. Your training expands.

500 LBS / 227 KG RATED. Industrial-strength steel, ships with bolts plus flat and lock washers so it goes up tight and stays tight.

The honest part: your anchor is only as strong as what you bolt into. Mount into solid wood, never drywall alone. Two minutes with a drill and you're set.

Already training with the door anchor built into your Human Trainer kit? The Ceiling Mount is the permanent upgrade for  more exercise angles, more stability, more places to set up a serious training station without giving up wall space or ceiling clearance. Pair two mounts with gymnastics rings for a full upper-body pulling and pressing setup that competes with any cable stack.

Pick your spot. Bolt it in. Train anywhere there's a ceiling.

Most bodyweight training moves in straight lines: you hold, you shift, you grind. That covers maybe half of how your body actually moves. The other half? Rotation. Explosion. Everything firing at once.

The Rotational Pulley Kit is the attachment that trains the half most people skip.It's all in the spin. Clip the free-spinning pulley to any anchor, run your strap over it, and the strap rotates freely, in any direction, through every rep. That single change turns slow, static holds into dynamic, rotational training that builds power, conditioning, and real-world agility simultaneously. Same Human Trainer setup, entirely different workout.

The movement list goes places a fixed strap can't. Two-arm rotational power pulls that build explosive pulling strength. Alternating chest presses that open the shoulders like a boxer. Woodchops. Anti-rotation holds. Using the included foot-cradle handles unlocks Spider-Man push-ups that link your hips, core, and upper body into one movement.

IT HITS WHAT OTHER TOOLS MISS. Because the pulley never stops moving, your core and stabilisers work the entire time, not just at the hard part. Balance, conditioning, and multi-planar strength built into every rep. It also scales the full range: gentle, assisted range-of-motion work for rehab or day one, all the way up to full-speed rotational power for athletes.

Want to take rotational core training further? The Adjustable Macebell builds on the same movement patterns with load.

SET IT UP ANYWHERE. The included Long Versatility Anchors rig to a rack, overhead beam, post, or tree, indoors or out. Living room today, backyard tomorrow, park on the weekend. Need a permanent overhead anchor point? The Ceiling Mount bolts inside a door frame and the door still closes. Pair two kits with gymnastics rings for a full upper-body pulling, pressing, and rotation station.

New to the Human Trainer system? The Rotational Pulley Kit is a progression add-on. Start with the Essential Kit and expand from there.

Quick feet are step one. Power is what pulls away.

Most agility ladders stop at footwork: shuffle through the rungs, get a little faster, call it a day. The Agility X-Training Kit goes further.

This is a resisted speed and agility training system, built to develop fast feet AND the force behind them. Two things most ladders never bother with simultaneously.

The kit pairs two agility ladders with a pair of Leg Cords—Yellow (light, 3–8 lbs / 1.4–3.6 kg) and Green (medium, 14-20 lbs / 6.4-9.1 kg)—that strap right at the ankle. Now every stride, cut, and lateral shuffle works against real resistance. That's the difference between quick feet and the kind of speed and agility that leaves people behind. IT STAYS WHERE YOU PUT IT. The number-one complaint about cheap agility ladders: they slide across the floor, the rungs won't stay spaced, and half your drill is spent resetting the thing. Four metal ground pegs pin it flat and square to the ground; rep one looks the same as rep fifty.

TWO LADDERS. ONE SERIOUS SETUP. Join them for a full 18 ft / 5.5 m straightaway or split them into two stations for a training partner or a full team session. Most kits give you one ladder and a shrug. This gives you options.

Built to take a beating with reinforced rungs, durable webbing, and Leg Cords backed by a LIFETIME REPLACEMENT WARRANTY. Not the thin, snap-prone stuff you tape back together and a seller you can never reach when it fails.

Want to take the resistance further as you get faster? Leg Cords come in five tensions all the way up to Black Sniper (extreme, 30–42 lbs / 13.6–19 kg). Add a heavier cord when the Green stops being a challenge. Pair the kit with the Human Trainer for a full outdoor agility workout that covers speed, power, and bodyweight strength in the same session.

Strap in. Get faster. Leave people behind.

description:
Amazon Best-Seller: Leg Cords

If you've ever spent half a squat set yanking a glute band back up your thighs, you already know the problem. Fabric and rubber loops roll. They slide. They pinch. Leg Cords don't, because they don't sit on your thighs at all.

A Leg Cord attaches at the ankle with an extra-large velcro strap that fits every ankle size. The resistance works from down low, where it belongs. As it's anchored at your ankle, it physically can't ride up or slide down. Through lunges, squats, lateral band walks, kickbacks, hip abductions, fire hydrants, and jumping jacks, it stays exactly where you put it.

PROGRESSIVE, COLOUR-CODED TENSION. Five levels run from Yellow (very light, 3–8 lbs / 1.4–3.6 kg) up through Black Sniper (extreme, 42-62 lbs / 19.1-28.1 kgs) — the load builds smoothly as the cord stretches, so you're actually progressing instead of buying loop after loop that all feel about the same. One glance at the tension chart tells you exactly which colour you need.

HIT THE MUSCLES MOST BANDS MISS. Leg Cords are built to target the inner and outer thighs, front and rear glutes — the stabilisers that carry over directly to running, sport, and daily life. Train them standing: lateral band walks, side kicks, donkey kicks, glute kickbacks, hip abductions. Train them on the ground: clamshells, fire hydrants, lying leg raises. Add them to squats and lunges for resistance that doesn't quit at the bottom of the rep.

SMOOTH STRAPS. NO DRAMA. No skin pinching. No leg-hair waxing mid-set. Just smooth, heavy-duty tubing that holds up to daily training without babying.

NOT SURE WHERE TO START? The Yellow + Green bundle is the perfect entry point. Yellow for warm-ups and footwork drills, Green for regular training. Together they cover everything from activation work to full-resistance lower body sessions. Step up to the full 5-pack to get the complete tension range and progress all the way to Black Sniper when you're ready.

Want to round out your lower body setup? The Glute Loop handles thigh and hip activation work when you want a traditional loop band that stays put. The Soft Glute Bench pairs perfectly for hip thrusts and floor work. And if you're training with The Human Trainer Bodyweight Suspension System or Ripcords, Leg Cords round out the full ankle-to-shoulder resistance system — everything in one bag.

Every Leg Cord is backed by a LIMITED LIFETIME WARRANTY and a 90-DAY SATISFACTION GUARANTEE for home use. Need a replacement within 90 days? We cover it — product and shipping. After 90 days, pay shipping only.

90 day warranty coverage for commercial use. Train hard. We've got the rest.

description:

Your training shouldn't be stuck wherever your gym is. The Human Trainer Essential Kit is a full bodyweight training system that lives in a mesh bag. Loop it over a door, a beam, a squat rack, or a tree at the park — you've got a few hundred exercises ready to go. No machines. No commute. Just you versus gravity.

THE DUAL-ANCHOR SYSTEM gives two independent anchor points. Two independent straps. Nothing converges into one spot to saw at your wrists, and each side moves on its own, so push-ups, dips, rows, and presses all feel cleaner and more stable than they ever do on a single-anchor trainer. This is the thing that separates the Human Trainer from everything else at this price point. Feel it on rep one.

FIVE D-RINGS. ZERO WASTED TIME. Each strap has five D-rings for height adjustment: unclip, snap into the next ring, keep moving. No cam buckle fighting. No time bleeding between exercises.

Here's the part nobody expects: change the height on one side, then the other, and both land at exactly the same position automatically. No going back and forth to eyeball it like you would with Olympic rings or other dual-anchor systems. (The cam buckle is still there for micro-adjustments when you want the length exact.)

500 LBS / 227 KG CAPACITY PER STRAP. Industrial nylon webbing that doesn't wobble, slip, or give you that stomach-drop feeling mid-rep. Lean into a heavy row. Throw your full bodyweight at a pull. The straps have you. Your anchor point is the only thing worth double-checking.

THE DOOR ANCHOR IS BUILT IN. Not a separate piece to buy, fumble with, or leave behind in a hotel room. The door anchor is integrated directly into the ends of both the main straps. Add the Short Versatility anchors for more options: on a rack, over a beam, or around a post. One kit. Every environment.

REAL RUBBER HANDLES. Not foam that turns into a sponge. Not hard plastic. Real rubber, fused to a durable foot cradle, one piece that flips from a press to a suspended plank to a hamstring curl without swapping anything out. Palms soaked? The grip stays. And because every strap has five D-rings, you can clip two sets on at once and run a superset without resetting your rig.

Start with the Human Trainer Essential Kit for presses, rows, and suspended core work. 

The Essential Kit ships with everything you need to start training on day one:

  • 2× Main straps with integrated door anchors
  • 2× Short versatility anchors with integrated door anchors (loop over a rack, beam, or post — or clip straight into a door)
  • 2× Integrated foot-cradle handles — rubber grip, durable cradle, one piece
  • 1× Detailed user manual with exercise demos
  • 1× Mesh carry bag

Upgrade to the Complete Training kit to add three Ripcords — Orange, Red, and Blue (light to very heavy) — with a Standard Door Anchor that turns any door into a cable station for curls, presses, rows, and rotations. Then the Leg Cords (Yellow and Green) strap around your ankles for warm-ups and lower-body work.

Every order comes with 30 days free for of the B.o.S. Training App for new users, and the detailed manual ships in the box, so you're ready to move on day one.

IMPORTANT: If training with a door anchor, position yourself so the door opens away from you, not toward you. Training in the wrong direction may cause the door to pull open under load.

You've seen the videos. Cheap resistance band snaps mid-rep, the person using them is knocked to another planet, everyone watching laughs, our social media guy saves it to make an ad. Don't let this be you.

Ripcords are premium tube bands with a real rubber grip moulded connected to every cord. Nothing to attach, nothing to lose, nothing to regret. You grab it and go.

REAL RUBBER HANDLES. Not foam. Not plastic. Not a clip-on that migrates south halfway through a set. The grip is fastened securely to the cord with ergonomic rubber that doesn’t break down like foam or crack like plastic. There on rep one and still there on rep one hundred.

THREE ANCHORS. EVERY ANGLE. ANYWHERE. Here's where Ripcords do something most tube bands can't:

  • Advanced Door Anchor - A soft-foam head that grips the top or bottom of the door frame. Set it high for cable pull-downs and face pulls. Set it low for rotational work and upward cable movements. If you've ever been stuck doing only flyes because your anchor only fits in the side of the door, this is the one.
  • Standard Door Anchor - Slots anywhere along the side of the door frame for a quick, no-fuss setup. In and training in under 30 seconds.
  • Versatility Anchor - Loops around a rack upright, a beam, a post, a tree or a fence post. Works anywhere with something solid to wrap around. 

SEVEN TENSIONS. COLOR-CODED. Yellow (very light, 3-8 lbs / 1.4-3.6 kg) up through Platinum (ultra extreme, 62–90 lbs / 28-41 kg). Rehab-light to seriously strong, all in the same system. One look at the resistance chart and you know exactly which color you need.

  • Yellow: extreme beginners, light mobility work.
  • Orange: warming up.
  • Green, Red and Blue: your working sets.
  • Black/Platinum: primarily for one-sided work: Anchor one side, loop it through, and use it mostly for rotational work.

Pick a single cord to fill a gap in your current setup, or step into a full set to cover the whole range.

Heavy-duty tubing built for daily use — none of the thin, sticky, disintegrates-in-a-warm-bag rubber that fills the bargain-bin reviews. A hundred-plus exercises. A setup that fits in a bag. A cable machine that lives in a doorway.

Already training with fabric resistance bands or mini bands? Ripcords are a different tool. Tube bands with cable-machine mechanics rather than flat loop bands for barbell work and bodyweight training.

Want to take cable-style resistance training even further? The Human Trainer turns suspension bodyweight work and resistance band training into a full-body system. Worth having all three. Find your tension and start pulling.

Fresh air. Real dirt under your shoes. Zero wait for the squat rack. Outdoor training just hits different, and that's not just the vitamin D talking (although, also that).

Turns out your backyard can absolutely be a real gym. Research consistently links outdoor workout sessions to a bigger drop in tension, anger, and stress than the same session done indoors. Same gains. Better mood. No membership required.

The Backyard Gym Bundle packs six purpose-built tools into one order, and together they cover strength, conditioning, power, mobility, and cardio without a single machine or an ounce of wall space:

  • Kettlebell - Swings, goblet squats, cleans, presses, Turkish get-ups. The most versatile single piece of equipment in the bundle.
  • Fitness Sandbag - Carries, shouldering, deadlifts, squats. The shifting load recruits stabilizers a barbell never touches.
  • Weighted Vest - Strap it on and everything gets harder. Pull-ups, push-ups, runs, carries — same movement, more resistance, zero equipment changes.
  • Slam Ball - Power, aggression, and conditioning in one piece of rubber. Slam it into the grass as hard as you want. It can take it.
  • Jump Rope - The most underrated conditioning tool in any gym. Three minutes of jump rope will remind you of that fast.
  • Glute Loop - Activation, mobility, and accessory work. Warm up, cool down, or add resistance to bodyweight movements.

Nobody trains at the same level, so the kettlebell, sandbag, and slam ball each come in multiple weight options. Pick what suits you now. Add weight later without buying a whole new bundle.

10% OFF VERSUS BUYING SEPARATELY. Same gear, same quality, just less damage to the wallet. The math is simple: six individually would cost more. The bundle doesn't.

And because gear without a plan just collects dew: every bundle comes with the Backyard Gym training program FREE in the B.o.S. app. Built specifically around these six tools. No substitutions, no guesswork, no standing in the yard wondering what's next.

We picked these six because together they cover the most ground for outdoor gym training, full stop. Step outside, unroll the mat (or don't — grass works fine), and get those gains, al fresco.

shortDesc:

description:
Amazon Best-Seller: Basilisk Stack Loaded Leg Extension / Leg Curl

If you’re here, you’re above the whole “skipping leg day” thing. A dedicated leg machine? No shortcuts. Big respect. A dedicated leg machine with a strength curve we obsessed over for years available with a beefy 310lb weight stack or a smart cable trainer compatible version? Now we’re talking.

Most leg extension/curl combos in this class tap out around 250 lbs. The Basilisk gives you three ways to load it: 210lb stack, 310lb stack, or the bring-your-own Voltra version. Just getting started? Go 210. Planning to build Quads of the Gods? Go 310. And if you outgrow the 210, there's a 100 LB upgrade kit with your name on it (figuratively). 

Already own a Voltra smart cable trainer? Skip the stack. The no-stack version swaps it for a dedicated cross member and a cheaper price tag, so you’re not paying for weight you don’t need. (Note: smart cable trainer is NOT included)

Let’s be honest, the stack number isn’t the magic. The strength curve is.

We didn’t just slap a cam on and call it a day. We fine-tuned the geometry and pivot points so extensions and curls feel right. Smooth where they should be. Challenging where they need to be. No weird dead spots. No “why does this feel off?” moments. Just clean resistance the whole way through.

That 40% slope on the seat? Not random. It’s the sweet spot.

We tested, we did the math (well...paid someone to). It puts your hip flexors where they need to be for quad isolation, and lines up your hamstrings properly for curls. We tested it. A lot. Probably more than we should admit. The result: it works.

Fit-wise, we’ve got you covered.The back pad adjusts. Seat and leg positions adjust enough to fit lifters from 5'3" to 6'2" without feeling like a compromise. The leg holder gets out of your way when you need it to. And the stack can go left or right — because your gym layout should adjust to you. Not the other way around.

Now let’s talk durability.

Aluminum pulleys. TPU cable. Not sexy… until your machine doesn’t jam mid-set.

Cheap machines bind. Cables wear out. That’s exactly why we built the Basilisk the way we did — smoother operation, longer lifespan, and backed by our no-nonsense warranty.

We also kept the height low — on purpose.

Tall machines waste vertical space. The Basilisk fits where commercial units won’t, which makes it just as at home in a garage as it is on a gym floor. And if you are running a facility, we’ve got custom logo plates and 60mm attachment compatibility ready to go.

End result?

You’re getting a machine that goes toe-to-toe with competitor options, only they charge $1,000–$2,000 more. Same features. Same performance.

The only real difference? The logo.

And we don’t charge extra for that.

IMPORTANT: The Voltra-compatible version does not include the Voltra.
